title: Campaign Management
content_data:
You can use Campaign Management API to set up your campaigns, ad groups, and ads. > **Important**
For details about ad creation through API, refer to [Use Cases](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1735713713137730). - To learn about campaign structure and the general workflow, see [Overview](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737585544915970). - To learn about the key settings and features at the campaign, ad group, and ad level, see [Guides](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739381695768577).
**See** [here](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740673047618561) to learn about mapping relationships between campaign features on TikTok Ads Manager and API configurations. - [Campaign](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1745292231199745): Campaigns are the highest level of advertising. To promote on TikTok for Business, you first need to create a campaign and set your advertising objective. ## Related use cases - [Create Shopping Ads](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1741942179356738) - [Create Spark Ads](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739470744631298) - [Create Lead Generation ads](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739470742024193) - [Create single image ads](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1777633230937090) - [Create Carousel Ads](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1766217791987713) - [Create an Upgraded Smart+ Campaign](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1843309449749698) - [Create Search Ads](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1780164603696130). - [Set up Reach & Frequency campaigns](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1758528372513794)
